body.name: Covariance-terminal elimination width \(\omega_p(G,G')\)
body.construction: For a common topological elimination order, expose the denominator-cleared factor-line constraints node by node; retain a latent node while it occurs in an unprocessed ancestor-support equation or terminal-copy linkage, and summarize processed baseline covariance terms by a running vector in \(\mathbb R^{p(p+1)/2}\). The active frontier is the retained latent set together with this fixed moment state. Define \(\omega_p(G,G')\) as the minimum, over common topological elimination orders and legal terminal-copy decompositions, of the largest active-frontier cardinality. A pair is \(w\)-tractable when \(\omega_p(G,G')\le w\).
